details.description: Nous Hermes 2 Yi 34B is a chat and instruction-tuned language model that Nous Research fine-tuned on top of 01.AI's Yi-34B base model. It was trained on roughly 1 million examples, primarily GPT-4-generated data plus other curated open datasets, and uses the ChatML prompt format for multi-turn conversations. It is released as an open-weight model under the Apache 2.0 license.
advantages: Scores 76.00% average on the GPT4All benchmark suite, per its model card.
Scores 50.27% average on AGIEval, per its model card.
Its model card reports it outperforms Nous Research's earlier OpenHermes-2.5 Mistral 7B model on GPT4All, BigBench, AGIEval, and TruthfulQA.
Uses the ChatML prompt format, which is compatible with OpenAI-style chat API clients.
disadvantages: English-language training data only, per its model card.
4,096-token context window, short next to more recent chat models.

notes: Fireworks AI's model page lists the context window as about 4,090 tokens, close to but not exactly the catalog's 4096; kept the catalog value. No maker docs page beyond the Hugging Face card was found; could not confirm a launch date or whether the model has since been superseded.
